capabilities: Incrementally sync Flomo memos into Obsidian with deduplication and deletion handling
Push Obsidian notes or selected text to Flomo via private API, webhook, or URL scheme
Import Flomo HTML/ZIP backups manually or through Playwright browser automation
Download and organize memo attachments with extension inference for Android uploads
Generate optional Flomo Canvas and Moments overview files
disambiguation: Despite the 'Importer' name, it also pushes Obsidian notes back to Flomo, not only importing them.
extras: README is mostly in Chinese (an English version is linked). Requires installing the Playwright browser binary (npx playwright@1.43.1 install). Push and pull rely in part on Flomo's reverse-engineered private API and WAF bypass, which may break when Flomo changes its site. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: 增强版分支，源自 jia6y/flomo-to-obsidian，包含重大改进
motivation: The author forked jia6y/flomo-to-obsidian to add major improvements, including fixing Playwright module loading failures that broke automated export in Obsidian's Electron environment.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import notes from the Flomo memo service or keep them in sync, and Flomo's official export is a manual ZIP download.
